verdict.rationale: Spline is a cloud-based design tool where files live in the cloud, so data retention and deletion controls are a fair question to ask. The evidence pack documents no retention settings, deletion controls, or policies for AI prompt or data handling. Version history (recovering earlier file states) and self-hosted export are adjacent features, not retention or deletion controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
